period_note: CONSOLIDATED (Group) basis, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series (see sources.json reporting_basis). Sourced from the bank's own full 'Consolidated Balance Sheet / Off-balance Sheet Items / Profit and Loss Account / Cash Flow Statement As at/For the period ended 31 March 2026 (Provisional and unaudited)' -- a genuinely richer, primary-document source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table used for prior years, and the FIRST TIME this bank's own separately-filed quarterly PDF (not the annual-report table) has been used in this dataset. ACCESS: southeastbank.com.bd's documented F5/BIG-IP WAF (fake HTTP 200 with a ~46KB 'Request Rejected'-style HTML body in place of the PDF) was confirmed again this session for plain curl against this exact URL -- but the WebFetch tool successfully retrieved the genuine 6.9MB scanned PDF where curl could not (verified via `file`: real PDF, 14 pages, not HTML). EXTRACTION TRAP: pdftotext -layout on this PDF returns real embedded text (not a blank scan) but the underlying subsetted font renders several digit glyphs incorrectly in a consistent, decodable way -- lowercase 't'/'I'/'l' frequently substitute for '1', 's' for '5', and in a few larger totals a '4' glyph renders as '1' (e.g. this filing's own printed 'Total liabilities' of 519,834,209,074 is arithmetically WRONG by exactly 30,000,000,000 against its own listed liability components, which sum to 549,834,209,074 -- the correct figure, confirmed three independent ways: (a) component sum, (b) Total Assets minus Total Equity minus NCI, (c) the balance-sheet identity closing exactly with Total Assets 585,315,616,496). Every figure below was decoded by resolving these glyph substitutions and then validated against at least one independent arithmetic identity (component sums, Total Operating Income = Net Interest Income + Non-interest Income, Profit before Provision - Total Provision = PBT, PBT - Tax = PAT) before being trusted; the few sub-BDT-1000 residual gaps in intermediate subtotals (immaterial, <0.0001%) are treated as residual OCR noise in figures not carried into this file. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header '1 January to 31 March 2026'); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter, consistent with the _cumulative-suffix convention already used for this bank's other interim quarters. STRONG CROSS-VALIDATION: this filing's own Net Profit after Taxation (1,317,869,696) exactly matches the value independently back-calculated from the separately-filed Half-Yearly filing (2026_Q2.json: H1-cumulative PAT 2,187,698,866 minus that filing's own discrete Apr-Jun bonus column PAT 869,829,170 = 1,317,869,696) -- two independently-downloaded documents agreeing to the taka. EPS (0.99) also matches DSE's own live 'Interim Financial Performance: 2026' table (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=SOUTHEASTB, Q1 column, EPS 0.990) exactly, a third independent source. BONUS DISCLOSURE: this filing's own Note 5/6 discloses a Solo-basis comparison alongside the Consolidated headline figures -- Solo Net Profit after Tax 1,247,029,674 (EPS 0.93) vs this file's Consolidated 1,317,869,696 (EPS 0.99); Solo NAV/share 26.40 vs Consolidated 26.49 -- confirming the real, small, consistent Consolidated-vs-Solo gap already documented for this bank (sources.json: 'CONSOLIDATED... one of 4 confirmed-consolidated banks'). Not used as line_items, recorded for cross-validation only.
